title: Generate PDF invoices

requirements.text: Amounts use integer minor units with currency precision; line, tax and grand totals are exact and consistent
Invoices include seller and buyer details, number, issue and due dates, line items and tax breakdown, with jurisdiction-specific fields configurable
Invoice numbers are unique and sequential per tenant, even under concurrent issuing
A real PDF is produced with embedded fonts, and long item lists flow across pages with repeated headers
Layout, branding and locale formatting are customizable without changing the data model
An issued invoice is stored immutably; corrections are made by credit note
Only authorized members of the tenant can download an invoice

evidence.name: storefront and utility sources compile strictly and behave

implementations.notes: invoiceTotals: exact integer tax rounding; no PDF
pdfme invoice/report templates with multi-page and font checks; tested inside the pack (npm test there), not in tests/. Tax rules and jurisdiction fields are out of scope

notes: Numbering, archival and access control are app work.
